subject: Film & Cinema
title: Satyajit Ray: India's Quiet Master
description: A 60-second lesson on Satyajit Ray: India's Quiet Master.

hook.text: With almost no budget, Satyajit Ray made a film that moved the entire world.

buildup.text: The Apu Trilogy followed one boy from childhood to adulthood with devastating simplicity.

discovery.text: Ray composed his own music, designed his own posters, and wrote his own scripts.

twist.text: He was virtually unknown outside India until Cannes discovered him in 1956.

climax.text: Kurosawa said: 'Not to have seen Ray's cinema means existing in the world without seeing the sun.'

quiz.question: What is Satyajit Ray's most famous work?
